_comment: The Home Assistant automation that receives SigNoz alert webhooks and pops a persistent_notification INSIDE Home Assistant - the demo beat where the loop closes. apply_alerts.py POSTs this to HA at POST /api/config/automation/config/signoz_alert_received (the config integration, included via default_config). The equivalent YAML lives in ha_webhook_automation.yaml and is mirrored into ha-config/automations.yaml so the seeded volume ships it. Keep the two in sync. HA 2026.7 no longer exposes persistent notifications in /api/states - read them via the WS command persistent_notification/get (see README).

config.description: Receives SigNoz alert webhooks (via the home-assistant-webhook notification channel) and pops a persistent notification inside Home Assistant - closing the observability loop: SigNoz detects, HA notifies.

variables.a: {{ (trigger.json.alerts | first) if (trigger.json.alerts is defined and trigger.json.alerts | count > 0) else {} }}
variables.aname: {{ a.labels.alertname if (a.labels is defined and a.labels.alertname is defined) else (trigger.json.commonLabels.alertname if (trigger.json.commonLabels is defined and trigger.json.commonLabels.alertname is defined) else 'SigNoz Alert') }}
variables.astatus: {{ (a.status if a.status is defined else trigger.json.status) | default('firing') }}

data.title: SigNoz [{{ astatus | upper }}]: {{ aname }}
data.message:
{{ a.annotations.description if (a.annotations is defined and a.annotations.description is defined) else (a.annotations.summary if (a.annotations is defined and a.annotations.summary is defined) else 'Alert received from SigNoz.') }}

Severity: {{ a.labels.severity | default('n/a') }} | fired at {{ now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') }}
